title: Chapter 88: The Final Battle Of The Camps (Iv)
content:
Chapter 88: The Final Battle Of The Camps (Iv)

"A real elite force?"

Wu Qing wanted to test the strength of the bear goblin dragon cavalry and see if there was a chance to keep the high priest.

The high priest is a higher-level priest in the evil god camp, with greater power and strength.

A Zerg team of more than 500 puppies deviated from the route of advance and rushed in the direction where the high priest left. The two sides were not far apart and soon collided face to face.

Wu Qing felt the strong sense of oppression brought by the charge of the bear goblin dragon cavalry through the vision of the charging puppies.

The tall dragon beast mounts charge fast, and their hard scales are like steel armor on their bodies. In terms of collision, ordinary Zerg puppies are not their opponents.

It was just a face-to-face encounter, and most of the Zerg puppies were knocked away.

The powerful bear goblin knights who sat on the backs of the dragon beast mounts were all star-level. The silver wolf armor sticks in their hands smashed down from a high position. The Zerg puppies would die if they were smashed, and they would be injured if they were touched.

This time, the Zerg puppies were just testing the attack, and their forces were at an absolute disadvantage. With just one charge, most of the puppies turned into light and disappeared.

The surviving puppies stopped intercepting and ran away.

Wu Qing and the Queen of the Bugs carefully observed the collision at this moment and found that the assault capability of this group of bear goblins' dragon cavalry was very strong. There were also many priests and a high priest whose strength was unknown. The result of organizing the Zerg to intercept was unpredictable.

Rather than intercepting this team of powerful enemies with a thankless effort, it would be better to focus on seizing more ready-made benefits on the battlefield ahead.

Wu Qing stopped chasing and intercepting, and the Tengu clan did not send troops to pursue, so the high priest of the bear goblins left the battlefield in a swagger.

On the battlefield of the decisive battle ahead, facing the violent army of evil gods, the Tengu clan turned to the defensive.

Although the Zerg puppies also chose to temporarily avoid the sharp edge, their attacks did not stop. They were sometimes scattered and sometimes gathered on the wide battlefield, constantly seizing opportunities to encircle and annihilate the enemy.

Five thousand Hydralisks were also divided into several teams of different sizes. Under the leadership of 25 one-star Hydralisks, they concentrated their fire on the huge targets and knocked down the enemies on the battlefield one by one.

More and more Zerg puppies joined the battlefield and rushed into the evil god army that had completely lost its formation.

The Zerg made full use of their ability to be "one heart". They cooperated tacitly and used various advantages to quickly encircle and annihilate the soldiers of the evil god army in full violent state.

The high-level officials of the Tengu clan became heavy-hearted as they watched the Zerg army's increasing strength and the Zerg's fierce, flexible and tacit fighting style.

"Gou Yin, I heard that you were the first to pay attention to and value this independent territory alliance and these Zerg on the battlefield?"

"Can you tell me about it?"

The elder of the Tengu clan, Gou Hong, asked Gou Yin on the side.

Now the situation on the battlefield has stabilized, and victory is certain. Once the evil god's army's faith blessing is exhausted, the Tengu clan's army can carry out the final massacre.

The Tengu clan's high-level officials also relaxed, and everything was stable!

If there were no accident with the Zerg, they would be cheering and celebrating now.

"Yes, elders!"

Gou Yin began to tell the elders and high-level officials of the Tengu clan about what he knew about the Zerg and the Independent Territory Alliance.

"I first learned about the Zerg from my younger brother."

"My younger brother is naughty. Not long ago, he handed his lord's scepter to a human. That human appeared with the Zerg."

"My younger brother exchanged a very strange piece of equipment from the Zerg. He often showed it off in front of me, so I noticed the Zerg."

"Later, they established an independent territory based on my younger brother's original territory."

"They fought several battles with the small mopping-up forces of the evil god camp alone, and won every battle."

"As a result, they were sought after by those independent territories. Under the leadership of the tiger leader, they wanted to form an independent territory alliance."

"I received this news and sent people to cause them some trouble. Later, my people brought back a lot of information about the Zerg."

"According to the tiger, the Zerg is a newly born race with the support of powerful people. I am preparing to report this to the elders!"

Speaking of this, Gou Yin looked a little solemn.

"So that's why they can make sacrifices on the battlefield."

"It seems that our dominance in this area is about to be challenged."

"However, their appearance allowed us to win this war, which can be regarded as stopping the trend of the evil god camp's continuous expansion in this area."

"We are now in the same camp, so it is not appropriate to confront them head-on for the time being. Gou Yin, you are responsible for continuing to pay attention to them."

The elder Gou Hong has seen the world and will not be moved by the background of the Zerg. He is just a little surprised that the Zerg chose to appear at this time.

He arranged Gou Yin to be responsible for the relevant affairs of the Zerg, and he did not continue to discuss this issue.

Perhaps in his eyes, the affairs of the Endless Mountains branch of the entire Tengu clan are insignificant.

...

On the battlefield, with the departure of the high priest, the various faith blessing states of the evil god camp army disappeared layer by layer.

After a period of time, the soldiers of various tribes in the evil god camp began to withdraw from the violent state. They either fell to the ground and died directly, or collapsed on the ground and lost their ability to move.

At this time, the number of Zerg puppies joining the battlefield has reached 50,000. They use their agile bodies and fast speed to shuttle around the battlefield, specifically looking for enemies that have exited the violent state to attack.

Now it is time to grab the results of the battle. As long as there is enough causal relationship with the Zerg, the system can harvest energy.

Therefore, more than 50,000 Zerg puppies are almost all integrated into the more than 100,000 evil god army, and every soldier in the evil god camp has been attacked by the puppies.

When facing the enemies in the violent state, the Zerg puppies will find the right opportunity to cut a few knives and retreat. As long as the enemies exit the violent state, they will not escape the fate of being finished off by them.

On the chaotic battlefield, corpses, blood, and the wreckage of weapons and equipment are everywhere, making it difficult for normal armies to move, but these difficulties have no effect on the Zerg puppies.

The Zerg arthropods are flying, and they are still moving fast.

The various armies of the Tengu clan camp also began to turn defense into offense and launched a final attack on the already weak evil god camp army.

The more than 100,000 troops left on the battlefield by the evil god camp were quickly destroyed by the fierce attack of the Zerg and the steady advance of the Tengu army.

In the blood-red sunset, the blood-covered and hideous puppy cut off the head of the last enemy, ending this extremely tragic battle between the camps.
